1688-alibaba-data-fetcher v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides a cross-platform solution for automated 1688 seller dashboard data extraction via a custom Chrome extension.
- Strictly enforces scripted workflows: all data collection, report generation, and Feishu push operations must use provided scripts only.
- Ensures complete browser isolation on Windows using a dedicated Chromium instance and three-layer validation—never connects to user’s Chrome.
- Skill communicates with users by outputting only necessary items (like login QR codes or final reports); suppresses intermediate progress or process details.
- Supports setup, browser management, data fetch, report generation, and Feishu notification/configuration across Linux and Windows.
- Data diagnosis and next-step recommendations can be customized; all other report contents are strictly script-generated and must not be altered manually.
